title: Exception to the Application of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019

content.scenario: A consumer from the State of Jammu and Kashmir purchases a defective product from a seller in New Delhi. The consumer files a complaint against the seller in a consumer court in New Delhi.
content.outcome: The consumer court in New Delhi will not have jurisdiction to hear the case as the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 does not extend to the State of Jammu and Kashmir.

user_queries: What is the jurisdiction of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019?
Can a consumer from Jammu and Kashmir file a complaint in a consumer court in New Delhi?
Is the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 applicable in Jammu and Kashmir?
